αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴτιός: αἴτιος — to blame, responsible; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate (accent from the enclitic ἐστιν)
αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., gen. of what one is glutted with, after ἆσαι: ’with blood’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on φόνον: ’of blood’ (φόνον αἵματος ’gore of blood’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a second person: ’you yourself’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself) · also periphrasis for a person, acc. subject of an infinitive: ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself) · also periphrasis for a person, governed by ἀμφί: ’around the might of Diomedes’ (= around Diomedes himself) · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὄπασσον: ’strength’ (ἴσην … βίην ’equal strength’)
βαίνει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; pres. 3 sg.
βλάπτουσ: βλάπτω — harm, hinder; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (βλάπτουσ’ = βλάπτουσα): ’harming’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενεῆς: γενεή — race, breed, stock; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic γενεᾶς), partitive after ἔκλεψεν: ’from that breed’; also antecedent of a relative: ’of the breed’ · also fem. gen. sg., of origin, with εἶναι: ’(to be) of this lineage’
γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a woman’ · also fem. gen. sg., possessive: ’of the wife’ (γυναικὸς … παρειαί ’the wife’s cheeks’) · also fem. gen. sg., objective, after ἔρος: ’desire for a woman’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δία: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Δία
δαναοὶ: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
διατρίβειν: διατρίβω — delay, put off, wear away; pres. inf. act., standing for a prohibition after μή: ’not to delay’
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό) · also adv. before ἀμπερές: ’through, right through’
δολοφρονέουσα: δολοφρονέω — plot craftily, think guile; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονοῦσα)
δόμεναί: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι), accented before the enclitic τε, complementing ἐθέλω: ’to give’
δώσω: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶρα: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of διδοῖς: ’gifts’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’)
εἰλείθυια: Εἰλείθυια — Eileithyia, goddess of childbirth; fem. nom. sg.
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., accented after a word with an accent on the last syllable but one (= Attic εἰσί(ν)): ’they are’
εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
εὐρυσθῆος: Εὐρυσθεύς — Eurystheus, king of Mycenae; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic Εὐρυσθέως)
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’ · also ’boasting’, of a claim
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θέαιναι: θέαινα — goddess; fem. nom. pl., epic by-form of θεά
θήβῃ: Θήβη — Thebe, city of Eëtion in the Troad; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’
θήσω: τίθημι — put, place; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall put’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, comrade-in-arms; masc. voc. pl., in address: ’servants (of Ares)’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ’attendants’
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’)

κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen., accented before the enclitic μευ: ’hear (me)’
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος: ’fair (plot)’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’good, fitting’ (οὐ καλὸν … εὐχετάασθαι) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔρνος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (καλὸν ἄειδε ’sang beautifully’)
καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἕλκος: ’strong, severe’ (τόδε καρτερὸν ἕλκος ’this severe wound’)

κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’)
κλισίῃσιν: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic κλισίαις)
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
κύδιστε: κύδιστος — most glorious, greatest; masc. voc. sg., superlative, address
λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
λαούς: λαός — people, men; masc. acc. pl.
λιγύς: λιγύς — clear-voiced, shrill; masc. nom. sg.: ’clear-voiced’
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.

μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. μαχέσθω: μάχομαι — fight, + dat.; pres. imper. mid./dep. 3 sg.: ’let him fight’
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, keeping in mind’
μενοεικέα: μενοεικής — satisfying, to one’s heart’s desire (μένος + ἔοικα); fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μενοεικῆ) · also neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic μενοεικῆ), agreeing with πολλά: ’satisfying things’
μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
μνησώμεθα: μιμνήσκομαι — be mindful of, remember (+ gen.); aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory: ’let us remember’
μογοστόκος: μογοστόκος — bringing on labour-pains, presiding at birth (μόγος + τίκτω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῆνιν: μῆνις — wrath, lasting anger (esp. a god’s); fem. acc. sg.
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νέεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔδει: οὖδας — ground, floor (Attic ἔδαφος); neut. dat. sg. οὔδει (also οὔδεϊ): ’on the floor’
οὔλυμπόν: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., accented before τε
πάντές: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέδησε: πεδάω — bind, fetter, hold fast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπέδησε): ’bound’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περικτιόνεσσιν: περικτίων — dweller around, neighbour (περί + κτίζω); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
πηλεΐδῃ: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. dat. sg.
πηλεΐωνος: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with φῦκος: ’much (seaweed)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱδρῶ: ’much (sweat)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with τρόφι: ’greatly’ (πολλὸν … τρόφι ’greatly swollen’)
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’

ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’wait!’
ἐπιεικές: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’as is fitting’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐχάρησαν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. (aor. pass. ἐχάρην): ’rejoiced’
ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep in check; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν): ’to hold’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’hold!’
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’ · also neut. nom. sg., with the article, of one’s belongings: ’his own’ (τὸ δ’ ἑὸν ’his own’)
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον): ’I spoke’
ἔμβαλον: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, cast on; aor. 3 pl. act. (ἐν + βάλλω): ’threw in’
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like’ (+ dat.: θεῇς … ἔοικεν ’is like goddesses’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔφη): ’he spoke’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕτερόν: ἕτερος — one of two, the other; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’one or the other’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠεροφοῖτις: ἠεροφοῖτις — walking in the mist or darkness; fem. nom. sg., epithet of the Erinys
ἡρακληείην: Ἡρακληεῖος (Ἡρακληείη) — of Heracles; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἡρακλεία), with βίην: ’the might of Heracles’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’ · also nom. pl., subject: ’the heroes’ (ἥρωες Δαναοί … διδοῦσιν)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἴδῃ), after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 sg. in a relative clause after ὅθι: ’wherever you see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 sg. in a condition after αἴ κεν: ’if you may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 sg. after πρίν γε: ’before you see’
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a general relative clause after ὅς κεν: ’whoever sees’
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀλέκοντα: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’destroying’
ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὁμάδῳ: ὅμαδος — din, uproar, noise of a crowd; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a roar’ · also masc. dat. sg. after ἐνί, of place: ’in the uproar’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄμοσσον: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic -σσ-
ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’rouse!’
ὄρσευ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ὄρσευ (= ὄρσεο): ’rouse yourself’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with its noun: ’as many (prizes) as’ (ὅσσά … ἀέθλια)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑμείων: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; gen. pl., epic ὑμείων (= Attic ὑμῶν): ’of you’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl. · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for whom’ · also ἵημι — send, hurl, throw; aor. subj. 3 sg., contracted, epic -σι (ᾗσι = ἕῃσι): ’throws’
ῥίον: ῥίον — crag, headland, jutting peak; neut. acc. sg.
